title: Uniform cohomological ranges for geometric duality and nearby cycles
statement:
Fix $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi_E^n)$ and $\ell\ne p$ [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. Over any separably closed field $F$ of characteristic $p$, and for every separated finite-type $F$-scheme $Z$, put $\omega_Z=Ra_Z^!A$ and $D_Z=R\mathcal Hom_A(-,\omega_Z)$, using the etale constructible exceptional operation and tensor--Hom adjunction as in [def-trf-dualizing-complex]. These formulas extend to bounded constructible complexes without a finite-Tor condition, and $D_Z$ takes such complexes to bounded constructible complexes. There is an integer $c_d$, depending only on a dimension bound $d$, such that $D_Z(D_c^{\leq0})\subset D^{\geq c_d}$ whenever $\dim Z\leq d$.

Let $B$ be an excellent strictly henselian [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] equal-characteristic-$p$ trait with algebraically closed residue field, and $X\to B$ separated of finite type, of dimension at most $d$. Let $R\Psi_X=i^*R\bar j_*$ on small etale sites, where $i:X_0\to X$, $\bar j:X_{\bar\eta}\to X$. Then $R\Psi_X$ has finite cohomological dimension bounded in terms of $d$, preserves bounded constructibility, and both exact contravariant functors
$$F_X=R\Psi_X D_{X_{\bar\eta}},\qquad G_X=D_{X_0}R\Psi_X$$
send $D_c^{\leq0}(X_{\bar\eta},A)$ into $D^{\geq b_d}$ for some integer $b_d$ independent of $X$ and of finite trait extensions. Their extensions to $D^-_c$ have the same lower bounds. The bounds for $F_X,G_X$ can also be chosen as functions of $\dim X_{\bar\eta}$ alone, independently of vertical components of $X$. The corresponding two functors $q^*D_Z$ and $D_{Z_K}q^*$ for a separably closed extension $K$ of an algebraically closed field $F$ also have uniform lower bounds depending only on $d$. All functors here are exact on their derived models. No assertion about an isomorphism between $F_X$ and $G_X$ is made.

Excellence of a scheme means excellence of its affine coordinate rings [def-exc-excellent-ring].
